title: Fix bugs in Rust 2x2 matrix operations
description: Brownfield Rust dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in 2x2 matrix operations (determinant uses wrong sign, transpose swaps wrong elements, multiply accumulates wrong products).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs.

Bug 1 — det: uses + instead of -.
  Fix: a * d - b * c

Bug 2 — transpose: swaps diagonal elements instead of off-diagonal.
  Fix: Matrix2x2::new(a, c, b, d)  // [[a,c],[b,d]]

Bug 3 — multiply top-right element: a*b should be a*f.
  Fix: change `a * b + b * h` to `a * f + b * h`

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: transpose swaps off-diagonal elements (b↔c), keeps diagonal
multiply top-right element is a*f + b*h
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
